dct_description_sm:
This data set contains concentrations of organophosphate flame retardants in wastewater Influent (INF), Effluent (EFF), Landfill Leachate (LCH), Biosolids (BIOS) and Sludge (SLG) sampled from various Wastewater Treatment Plants (WWTP's) and Landfills across Canada.

Supplemental Information

Supporting Projects: Chemicals Management Plan (CMP) Wastewater Monitoring Program
dct_title_s: Organophosphate Flame Retardants in Canadian Municipal Wastewater Treatment Systems
